table.retrieve:
SELECT
	ICode=I.ICode,
	ItemName=I.Name, 
	AliasName=I.CustomICode,
	Category = (SELECT C.Name FROM ItemCategory C WHERE C.ICatCode=I.ICatCode),
	Supplier = (SELECT MAX(A.Name) FROM Accounts A, ItemSuppliers IP WHERE IP.ICode = I.ICode AND IP.SuppCode = A.AccCode),
	UserName = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=I.UserCode),
	PurDiscPerc = I.PurDiscPerc, 
	PurPrice=ROUND(I.PurPrice / I.PackUnits, 2),
	SalePrice=ROUND(I.SalePrice / I.PackUnits, 2),
	Date=I.OriginalDate,
	ChangeReason = I.ChangeReason,
	Module = I.Module
FROM
	Item I
WHERE I.OriginalDate BETWEEN  :ad_startdate  AND :ad_enddate AND
	I.ICode NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ItemLog.ICode FROM ItemLog)
UNION
SELECT
	ICode=I.ICode,
	ItemName=I.Name, 
	AliasName=I.CustomICode,
	Category = (SELECT C.Name FROM ItemCategory C WHERE C.ICatCode=I.ICatCode),
	Supplier = (SELECT MAX(A.Name) FROM Accounts A, ItemSuppliers IP WHERE IP.ICode = I.ICode AND IP.SuppCode = A.AccCode),
	UserName = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=I.UserCode),
	PurDiscPerc = I.PurDiscPerc, 
	PurPrice=ROUND(I.PurPrice / I.PackUnits, 2),
	SalePrice=ROUND(I.SalePrice / I.PackUnits, 2),
	Date=I.OriginalDate,
	ChangeReason = I.ChangeReason,
	Module = I.Module
FROM
	ItemLog I
WHERE 
	I.OriginalDate BETWEEN  :ad_startdate  AND :ad_enddate AND
	STR(I.ICode, 15) + STR(I.ItemRowID, 15) IN
		(SELECT DISTINCT A=STR(M.ICode, 15) + STR(MIN(M.ItemRowID), 15)
		FROM ItemLog M
		WHERE M.OriginalDate BETWEEN  :ad_startdate  AND :ad_enddate
		GROUP BY M.ICode)
ORDER BY ItemName
table.sort: date A, itemname A, aliasname A
